newsitem.title: FRANCE: French shares trade down 3.47 pct, above lows.
newsitem.headline: French shares trade down 3.47 pct, above lows.

text.p: French shares traded sharply lower but above lows on market rumours of private opinion polls showing the left could win an election runoff on Sunday, brokers said.

Share analysts have estimated the CAC could fall to 2,450 to 2,500 if the left wins. But if the Socialists won an outright majority they would not need to rely on the Communists for votes and would be able to pursue more centrist policies, they added.
* CAC-40 index down 92.91, or 3.47 percent, at 2,587.43 at 1131 GMT. Low was 2,561.23.
* CAC-40 May futures 2,584 vs 2,679 at Tuesday's close.
